blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: TRAI aims to establish and promote fair competition across all telecom markets.
Safeguarding consumer interests and maintaining quality service standards are core objectives.
Encourages continuous technological innovation and supports the expansion of telecom infrastructure.
Exams frequently ask about the twin regulatory focus of TRAI: market competition and consumer interest protection.
Note that driving technological innovation and expanding infrastructure are explicit statutory objectives of TRAI.
